lines.en: - And there! - That's how you make...
- Carly here? - Nah, she didn't say I went to build a bra.
They're almost kicking me out of that place.
Why'd you take off your shirt?
Uh, to relax in the dark.
So... isn't there something you would...
rather do than watch the movie?
Oh my God, this pie is huge!
And it contains your two favorite flavors!
And this is the real Gibby!
- Wait, we forgot Gibby. - Oh, yeah.
- What's up? - Gibby? Why are you wearing that?
You told me I was gonna be the ring bear.
- Hey, you there, stop. - Oh, hey, Mr. Howard.
You know the rules. You are required to wear a shirt during school hours.
Aha. No tube tops, no jolly pants, no turtlenecks.
Doesn't say I gotta wear a shirt, does it?
Hey, there. When I wake up in the middle of the night screaming,
this is a song my mom sings to calm me down. Ready?
Um, um, is it a basket?
Oh, wrong! Not a basket! Listen to your tongue!
My tongue is still numb from the mustard.
Gibby, Gibby, Gibby, Gibby, Gibby, Gibby, Gibby, Gibby!
- Yeah? - Your daddy is here to pick you up!
Oh, boy. I'm on my way.
Hey, can I keep this bucket of hair?
Whee! I'm a bird! I'm a bird!
Oh, my God. Look at him fly, Gibby's flying.
Okay, but first, I'll need to christen you with this novelty non-alcoholic champagne bottle.
Yeah, but I couldn't think of anything.
